Primary request: the mouth of the old diversion valley behind Nangou. The foreground holds a narrow fork in a rough rising footpath: one steep lane climbs to safety, while the other follows an old shallow stone channel into an uninhabited misty valley. Three small lived-in timber cottages stand along the far left slope and a modest rectangular medicinal herb plot lies beside the channel, showing precisely what will need evacuation and may be sacrificed. Three old stone posts mark the channel, with the third visibly tilted and displaced amid fresh mud. A simple paper sensing talisman with abstract red strokes is attached to one post; no readable text. The valley itself opens deep into the center distance, empty of homes.
Composition: eye-level wide three-quarter establishing view. The narrowing fork, cottages, herb plot and tilted post must be understandable at ordinary human scale and visible in the central middle band above the lower dialogue panel. Clear standing space at right for separate character portraits. Low-detail foreground path at the bottom. Keep important objects in the central 16:9 safe crop. Empty scene without characters.
Lighting and style: polished realistic Chinese fantasy environment illustration, restrained jade/teal mountains, muted warm timber and pale weathered stone, subtle mist and soft gold sunlight. Practical terrain with real distances and a narrow passage, not a huge decorative magic arena.
Avoid: giant sect gateways, floating islands, colossal stairs, modern pipes or electric devices, active flood, destroyed cottages, glowing magic circles, readable characters, text, captions, UI, frame, logo or watermark.
